apihelp-strikevote-summary: Waxay u oggolaanaysaa maamulayaasha inay tirtiraan ama soo celiyaan cod.
apihelp-strikevote-param-option: Dooro tallaabada la qaadayo: ka saar ama soo celi cod.
apihelp-strikevote-paramvalue-option-uns: Soo celi cod (dib ugu dar tirinta).
apihelp-strikevote-param-voteid: Aqoonsiga codka la tirtirayo ama la soo celinayo.
apihelp-strikevote-param-reason: Sababta loo saarayo  ama loo soo celinayo codka.
apihelp-strikevote-example-strike: Ka saar codka <kbd>1</kbd>, adigoo bixinaya sababta <kbd>ku celcelin</kbd>.
apihelp-strikevote-example-unstrike: Soo celi codka <kbd>1</kbd>, adigoo bixinaya sababta <kbd>khalad</kbd>.
apierror-securepoll-mustbeloggedin-strik: Waa inaad gasho akoonkaaga si aad uga saarto ama u soo celiso cod.
apierror-securepoll-badvoteid: <kbd>$1</kbd> ma aha aqoonsi cod oo sax ah.
apihelp-securepollauth-summary: Waxay u oggolaanaysaa wiki fog inuu xaqiijiyo isticmaalayaasha ka hor inta aan loo oggolaan inay ka codeeyaan doorashada.
apihelp-securepollauth-param-token: Calaamad ku salaysan calaamadda gelitaanka isticmaalaha.
apihelp-securepollauth-example-auth: Xaqiiji isticmaalaha leh aqoonsiga <kbd>1</kbd>, iyo calaamadda gelitaanka <kbd>123ABC</kbd>.
